items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: George, George, George. We had our picture taken some time ago.

ctx.x: Who do you think was the best of your own pupils on clarinet? I don't remember that. If you had to pick out the best of the musicians that you taught, who would you think was the best of them? I can't get you there.

George, George, George. We had our picture taken some time ago. Is he still paying? Oh yeah. Uh huh. Here in New Orleans? Yeah. He's with... He's with... He's with... I follow the Royal Street there. . .
